design.name: 火麒麟·焚身
design.brief: Chapter boss, the Fire Qilin (火麒麟), SECOND form 'burning body' (焚身): the SAME qilin as the first form after its black-iron scales have burst off — a colossal qilin (麒麟) about 4.5 m tall at the head and 7 m long with real hoofed-animal anatomy and TALL, LONG-LEGGED horse-and-deer proportions (long slender powerful legs with big cloven hooves, a long arched horse-like neck that carries the head high, a deep chest, a lean deer-like body with a tucked waist, an ox-like tail ending in a big tuft) — NOT a lion, NOT a foo dog, NOT stocky or short-legged and a fierce dragon-like head with a broad snout, long whiskers, a lion-like mane of big solid sculpted flame-shaped locks, and ONE long single horn rising from the forehead with a glowing lava-orange fire pearl set at its root (weak spot). Its body is now cracked molten lava rock: dark crust plates with wide glowing yellow-orange fissures; its mane and tail tuft have erupted into much bigger solid sculpted flames in vermilion, orange and yellow; cloud-shaped flame scrolls curl around its hooves (it runs on air, 踏云); a big glowing molten heart core is exposed in the middle of its chest where the scales broke away (weak spot, together with the horn pearl). A few broken black-iron scales still cling to its shoulders and haunches. Faster, wilder, blazing.
design.style_note: Stylization: cartoon game proportions in the same family as the desert and frost rosters (jerboa soldier, fire rat, sancai tomb beast, golden snub-nosed monkey): chunky simplified masses, oversized heads and hands or paws, toy-like readable forms with clean bevelled edges. Iron, basalt and bronze as a few big faceted plates with sparse painted wear; lava and fire painted as OPAQUE glowing cracks, seams and solid sculpted flame shapes (never transparent fire, smoke or particles); fur, hair and feathers as a few large carved clumps. A boss: grand and iconic, still in the same chunky stylized language. Show the whole qilin leaping through the air.
design.turnaround_lead: Boss model, second form (burning body), neutral bind pose for rigging:
design.turnaround_pose: standing ON ALL FOURS like a real horse or deer (quadruped), body level, the four legs straight and planted, front and hind legs clearly separated with a gap of air between them, belly clear of the ground; the head held up and level facing straight ahead, mouth closed, the single horn pointing up and slightly forward with the pearl at its root painted opaque glowing orange (no halo); the chest heart core painted opaque glowing yellow-orange; the big flame mane, the flame tail tuft and the cloud-flame scrolls at the hooves as SOLID sculpted shapes attached to the body (no loose fire, no smoke, no sparks, no floating pieces)
design.turnaround_digits: each foot with two cloven hoof toes; the horn tip, the whole flame mane and the whole tail fully inside the frame; in the side views the long body and tail must fit inside the view with margin.
design.design_note: DS v001 was stocky and lion-like, too close to the desert sancai tomb beast; v002 asks for tall horse/deer proportions.
